scope: Source-only cost inventory; no material-cost or compatibility acceptance claim
mechanism: Copy exact prior reviewed E020-based host training terminal consolidation, including existing geometry/fallback unit and lifecycle schedule controls.
new_persistent_host_state: One u32 terminal_grid_limit field. Rust struct padding/size impact was not measured; no new source-level heap container.
constructor_cost: One MAX_GRID_DIM_X device-attribute query before stream work. Error/nonpositive result chooses old schedule without a new construction error.
host_scheduling_cost: Stack Option<[LevelSpan;2]> and once(None).chain(reverse levels) iterator, checked full lengths and branches; no source heap allocation added. Extra empty initial phase exists on fallback.
gpu_graph_and_locality_cost: Terminal grid sizes, execution order and graph node counts change; block dimensions, shared bytes, kernel bodies and per-node CTA work remain exact. Actual graph/executable allocations, scheduling/locality effects and complete-cycle compatibility are not proven cost-free.
fallback: Both terminal lengths must fit i32 and the positive queried grid limit; otherwise both preserve original per-level terminal schedule. Existing per-level bounds remain preexisting. No capability is inferred from earlier samples.
test_independence_limit: The existing legacy_iteration forces terminal_grid_limit0 but shares dispatcher code. Immutable accepted E020 executable and later original controls remain the independent oracle.
required_before_adoption: Fresh geometry/lifecycle/eager/profile/evaluation/standalone feature-continuation controls and actual consolidation/fallback/capacity behavior, including any material graph-memory change, plus fixed user1% confirmation/fixture/holdout/cumulative requirements.
